title: Many uses
text: Many uses. These baskets are not only sturdy, they’re decorative.  I already had 2, and I ordered 2 more.  I use them to hold all of the remote controls in the living room, my night table for hearing aid supplies, and in my bathroom to hold disposable hand towels.  Every room could use 1 to hold pens, pads, all sorts of items we use regularly, and keep things looking tidy.
